questions.stem: 5.6 g of iron reacts with 3.2 g of sulfur: Fe + S → FeS. What is the maximum mass of iron(II) sulfide formed? (Ar: Fe = 56, S = 32)
questions.explanation: Moles of Fe = 5.6/56 = 0.1 mol. Moles of S = 3.2/32 = 0.1 mol. The equation shows a 1:1 ratio, so both are used up completely. Moles of FeS = 0.1 mol. Mr of FeS = 56 + 32 = 88. Mass = 0.1 × 88 = 8.8 g.
